name: World Peace Cookies
subtitle: Found by Eliza
time: ~4 hr 15 min, ~55 min hands-on (mostly chilling; estimated)

items: ¾ dark chocolate chips, preferably mini

steps.title: Cream the butter and sugars
steps.body: Beat together until fluffy: **1 stick + 3 Tbsp butter**, softened, **⅔ cup light brown sugar**, **¼ cup sugar**, **¼ tsp salt** and **1 tsp vanilla**.

steps.title: Mix in the flour and cocoa
steps.body: Mix in **1¼ cups flour**, **⅓ cup unsweetened cocoa powder** and **½ tsp baking soda**.

steps.title: Add the chocolate chips
steps.body: Add **¾ dark chocolate chips**, preferably mini.

steps.title: Shape and chill
steps.body: Shape dough into 1½-inch diameter logs, wrap into plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 3 hours.

steps.title: Slice and bake
steps.body: Slice into ½-inch slices, and place on a baking pan. Bake at 325°F for 12 minutes.
